document_name: AB-2026-05648-197-2027 RFP Learning Management System (LMS) Platform  Support (2).pdf

extracted_fields.submission_method: Electronic submission by email to submissions@oldscollege.ca
extracted_fields.contract_term: Five (5) years base term, with options for two (2) separate three (3) year renewals, up to a maximum total of eleven (11) years.
extracted_fields.scope_of_deliverables: Provision of Learning Management System (LMS) Platform & Support (either enhancing existing Moodle LMS support or implementing a new LMS).
extracted_fields.mandatory_submission_requirements: Completion and signing of Section C Item 9 'Proposal Certification Document'.
extracted_fields.mandatory_technical_requirements: Must meet specifications detailed in Scope of Work (Section D) including functional, technical, accessibility, mobile, security, integration, and cloud-based system requirements.
extracted_fields.evaluation_criteria: Company Experience (15 points), Staff/Resource Experience (5 points), Proposed Solution and Approach (40 points), Pricing (40 points). Total: 100 points.
extracted_fields.minimum_score_threshold: Satisfactory outcome on reference checks (yes/no pass threshold).
extracted_fields.pricing_requirements: Fixed prices in CAD for the 5-year agreement, itemized by Implementation Costs (one-time) and Ongoing LMS Licensing/Support Costs (annual subscription).
extracted_fields.minimum_insurance_requirements: Comprehensive General Liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 inclusive per occurrence; 'All risks' property insurance.
extracted_fields.vendor_experience_qualifications: Demonstrated experience providing LMS systems and support, and experience working with post-secondary institutions (including Ellucian Banner).
extracted_fields.number_of_references_required: Three (3) references for similar goods and services provided.
extracted_fields.data_security_privacy_requirements: Adhere to Province of Alberta information privacy standards (POPA), Access to Information Act (ATIA), SAML-based Single Sign-On (SSO), and HECVAT cybersecurity & privacy assessment.
extracted_fields.data_hosting_residency_requirements: Cloud-based platform with preference given to a Canadian host location.
extracted_fields.vendor_demonstration_requirement: Yes, product demos and vendor interviews scheduled for shortlisted proponents between September 15 - November 15, 2026.
